problem: Let $C={{c}_{1},{c}_{2}}$ be a basis of ${R}^{2}$ and $[x]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 5\end{aligned}].$ What are the coordinates of $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ where ${b}_{1}=2{c}_{2}$ and ${b}_{2}=-5{c}_{1}?$
worked_solution:
Since $[x]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 5\end{aligned}]$, we can write $x$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =-3{c}_{1}+5{c}_{2} \\  & =5{c}_{2}-3{c}_{1} \\  & =\frac{5}{2}(2{c}_{2})-\frac{3}{5}(5{c}_{1}) \\  & =\frac{5}{2}{b}_{1}+\frac{3}{5}{b}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}\frac{5}{2} \\ \frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}].$
